integrity.claim_scope: Complete homotopy-type filtration for one finite shortest-path metric.
integrity.literature_risk: Checked primary literature and published-finding corpus did not reveal the Pappus filtration; an unindexed computation under graph-power clique-complex terminology could still exist.
integrity.reproducibility: The standard-library verifier reconstructs the graph, face sets, scale-2 Morse matching, distance-4 graph, and mod-2 boundary ranks from the stated LCF word.

scientific_limitations: Exact for the 18-vertex Pappus shortest-path metric and the inclusive Vietoris–Rips convention.
No classification of cubic symmetric or distance-regular graphs is asserted.
The homotopy types at thresholds are determined, but the inclusion maps are not classified up to homotopy.
title: Complete graph-metric Vietoris–Rips filtration of the Pappus graph
